{{Top|leg}}
The '''Guild of Armament Distributors''' was a [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] [[Wroonian Guilds|guild]]. It was declared illegal by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Norrin]] and its guild hall was raided by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces. [[Kabalard Vinne]], a representative of the Guild before it was dissolved, later led a retaliation [[Raid on the Wroona Stardock|strike]] on the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Rampant]]'' in the [[Wroona Stardock]].
